newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: GENCHIU PLANS $25 MLN PRODUCTION FACILITY.
newsitem.headline: GENCHIU PLANS $25 MLN PRODUCTION FACILITY.

text.p: Lithuania's Genchiu oil company on Tuesday said that it plans to complete a $25 million oil production facility this year.
"Now our main aim is to finish the production facility and through this to increase production to 200,000 tonnes," Kestutis Ivanauskas, Genchiu deputy general director, told Reuters.
"We're planning to finish construction on the oil production facility this summer, maybe August or September," Ivanauskas said. "It will cost about $25 million."
Ivanauskas said he expected the facility to boost Genchiu's production figures this year.

"Last year, we produced 84,000 tonnes, and this year, with the new production facility maybe we'll produce about 100,000 tonnes," Ivanauskas said. "We have plans to increase production to 200,000 tonnes."

Genchiu Nafta, a joint venture between Lithuania's Geonafta and Sweden's Svenska Petroleum Exploration, employs about 30 people but staff numbers will be up to 50 to 60 with the new facility, Ivanauskas said.
Dutch company Tebodin and Lithuania's Hidrostatyba are the main contractors working on Genchiu's production facility, which will be located 20 km outside Klaipeda, Ivanauskas said.
